patient.name: Noah Kim
patient.presenting_event: Fell forward on an outstretched left hand while skateboarding 4 hours ago.

history.chief_complaint: Lateral left elbow pain 5/10 and difficulty turning the palm upward.
history.mechanism: Axial load transmitted through extended elbow.
negative: No gross deformity or open injury
No wrist pain or shoulder pain
history.goal: Return to desk work and controlled sport

inspection: Small lateral elbow swelling without gross deformity
palpation: No DRUJ, wrist or interosseous membrane tenderness
movement: Elbow flexion 30–120 degrees limited by pain
Forearm pronation/supination painful but no true mechanical block
neurovascular: Radial, median, ulnar motor/sensory function intact
safety_red_flags: Associated wrist/DRUJ pain suggesting longitudinal instability

learning_objective: Identify subtle Mason I injury, check associated instability and balance short comfort support with early motion.
